chunks: Orient Cables makes networking cables, the LAN cables inside offices and data rooms, plus specialty power cables, optical-fibre cables and cable harnesses, including E V charging-gun assemblies.
The RHP's industry report puts it among India's top four networking-cable makers, with about 22.9% share in FY26.
It runs two plants in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, and a new Bengaluru plant that started in May 2026.
